data.one_liner: Command-line tool to identify and clean unused localization keys from ARB files.
data.what_it_does: Scans Flutter project files to detect unused localization keys within .arb translation files. Provides interactive or automated options to remove them and supports easy_localization patterns.
use_when: You want to clean up unused translation keys from ARB files
Your project uses Flutter's built-in localization or easy_localization
avoid_when: You need automated CI/CD checks for unused keys (not yet documented)
You use localization packages other than built-in or easy_localization
strengths: Supports multiple language files and custom paths
Handles both Flutter built-in localization and easy_localization patterns
Offers safety flags like --keep-unused to simulate deletion
weaknesses: CI/CD integration is listed as an upcoming feature in the roadmap
Limited to specific supported localization formats
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and run via dart run.
